data.one_liner: Parse and evaluate mathematical expressions in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a parser that converts math strings into a tree of nodes and can calculate results with custom variables and functions. Supports equations, definite integrals, and custom function definitions.
use_when: You need to evaluate user‑provided formulas at runtime
You require custom variables or functions in calculations
You want a pure‑Dart solution without native dependencies
avoid_when: Performance‑critical numeric computing where a compiled library is needed
Complex symbolic algebra or calculus beyond definite integrals
strengths: No external native dependencies, works on all Flutter platforms
Supports custom variables, functions, and definite integrals
Clear API with documented node tree
weaknesses: Limited to simple math; no symbolic manipulation or advanced calculus
Parsing errors can be verbose and may require manual handling

alternatives.name: petitparser
alternatives.why_pick_it: A flexible parser combinator library that can be used to build custom math parsers with more control
